<a name="Core"></a>
## type [Core](<https://github.com/sbimasena/Tugas3_IF4020_17/blob/main/internal/core/core.go#L18>)

Core adalah implementasi contract.Core. Tidak perlu diinisialisasi, cukup core.Core\{\}.

```go
type Core struct{}
```

<details><summary>Example</summary>
<p>



```go
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"kelompok17/internal/core"
)

func main() {
	var c core.Core
	msg := []byte("halo")
	privPEM, pubPEM, _ := c.Generate("ecdsa-p256-sha256")
	priv, alg, privID, _ := c.LoadPrivate(privPEM)
	sig, _ := c.Sign(alg, priv, msg)
	pub, _, pubID, _ := c.LoadPublic(pubPEM)
	fmt.Println(alg, privID == pubID)
	fmt.Println(c.Verify(alg, pub, msg, sig), c.Verify(alg, pub, []byte("lain"), sig))
}
```

#### Output

```
ecdsa-p256-sha256 true
true false
```

</p>
</details>
